GENERATE BURST AL-1-copy — Run C-9 P4, FIDELITY LADDER step 1: COPY (Matt R-C9-29: put the angel and demon in the scene). task_id "AL-1-copy".

THIS IS A COPY, NOT A NEW PAINTING. Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1. Keep the ORIGINAL PAINTER'S HAND: the exact line, the brushwork, the gold, the worn pigment, every small imperfection. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE SOURCE ITSELF: do NOT re-render, re-line, smooth, clean up, sharpen or restyle anything.

Change ONLY this: the armoured archangel Saint Michael (winged, haloed, with his spear, round cross shield and red cloak) stands on a heap of demons and on a tiled floor in front of a gold brocade wall. REMOVE the demons under his feet, the tiled floor and the gold brocade wall; where the demons covered his feet and lower legs, complete his armoured legs and feet standing on nothing, in the same hand. Keep his halo, wings, spear, shield, cloak, armour and every painted detail exactly. Replace everything that is not the figure with flat uniform pure #00ff00. Keep the figure's proportions, colours and pose exactly; the full figure, head to feet, must be inside the frame.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the figure was redrawn or restyled rather than preserved, part of the figure is missing, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/AL-1-copy_a.png and out/AL-1-copy_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "AL-1-copy"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE SOURCE TO EDIT (preserve the painter's hand exactly)
